variables.name: Explanation
variables.formula: ["You can see clearly through all of these objects because they allow light to pass through them.","All of these items can be bent, folded, or curved easily without breaking.","If you run your hand over any of these items, their surfaces feel bumpy, uneven, and scratchy.","These objects are brittle and will easily crack, shatter, or break if dropped or put under pressure.","All of these objects have very low friction, meaning things will slide across them easily.","These items contain metals like iron or steel, which are attracted to magnets.","These items have even, level surfaces without bumps or ridges, making them feel sleek to the touch.","All of these objects are made of metal, making them good conductors of heat and electricity.","These objects are gentle to the touch and easily change shape or compress when squeezed.","These substances do not have a fixed shape or volume; they expand to fill whatever container they are in.","These objects are less dense than water, allowing them to stay at the surface of the water.","These objects are denser than water, causing them to fall to the bottom when submerged.","When mixed into water, these substances break down completely and blend into the liquid.","Even if placed in water for a long time, these items will not break down or dissolve into the liquid.","These items have tiny pores or spaces that easily draw in and hold liquids.","These materials do not let water pass through them or soak into them.","These liquids have high internal friction, meaning they are thick and flow slowly compared to water.","These items have very little mass and can easily be moved or blown away by a gentle breeze.","These objects have a high mass relative to their size, requiring significant force to pick up.","These substances have a definite volume but no fixed shape, flowing to match the shape of whatever container holds them.","All of these metals easily allow electric currents to flow through them.","These materials block the flow of electricity, making them safe to use to shield electrical currents.","These objects are made of metal, meaning heat travels through them rapidly, which is why they are great for cooking.","These materials are poor conductors of heat, so they help block or slow down the transfer of heat.","These materials have a rigid structure that makes them highly
